clauses.instruction: Acquire the Slack channels needed to determine message counts and channel membership.
Acquire messages for every acquired channel so each channel's message count can be computed.
Count the messages in each acquired channel, preserving alignment with the acquired channel list.
Select a channel with the smallest acquired message count.
Acquire current users for every acquired channel so all known channel users and selected-channel membership can be determined.
Flatten the acquired channel membership lists into the set of all acquired users.
Look up the acquired membership list aligned with the selected channel.
Select the acquired users who are not already members of the selected channel.

For every exact identity in the closed users_to_add difference, add that identity to the selected smallest-message channel. The finite Conditional output is the complete effect domain; do not semantically regenerate or rename any user.
